title: A time-sensitive brief never rests on an aggregator alone
replays: The 2 Nov class: the commute brief credited disruptions to grandcentralrail.com and london-now.co.uk. The owner-voice rule says a time-sensitive brief cites the primary source, never an aggregator alone.
